projectState.summary: Byte 13b-c1 hardens the low-frequency persistence writer before `musical.event_recorded`: no-db status/dump reports an uninitialized DB instead of creating one, queued records retry with bounded backoff, `window.persistence.flushOnPageHide()` sends a best-effort beacon/keepalive batch without removing queued records, and the Session inspector shows persistence status/pending/error details. Smoke now covers a forced append outage and verifies the app remains usable while records stay pending. High-frequency musical event persistence remains deferred to a ring-buffer/batch-flush slice.
